# [GOV] W17: Branch-merge verdicts

**Status:** PROPOSED
**Issue Type:** `GOVERNANCE`
**Change Class:** `CONTRACT_GOVERNANCE` (verdicts only; merges executed by human maintainer only)
**Labels:** `type:governance`, `triage`, `risk:high`
**Owning Authority:** WORK_ITEM_POLICY §6 (protected main, owner approval), AGENTS.md §7 (no autonomous merge — this issue AUTHORIZES NOTHING automatic; each merge needs its own human-executed merge)
**Milestone:** V8.6 — Production Recalibration (Phase 5)

## 1. Objective
Per-branch verdict using W15/W16 receipts: MERGE (what subset) / HOLD (branch-bound) / CLOSE (superseded). Mandatory sub-verdicts: (a) external-substrate strategy (LEAN/skfolio/vectorbt in-branch vs Nautilus in W10/W14 — one strategy); (b) CPCV home (S7 vs benchmark/); (c) FREEZE-exception ruling if any merge grows main surface.

## 2. Scope
`feat/d153-benchmark-fabric` + 6 perf branches + open #332–#336 linkage.

## 3. Normative Traceability
- R1: W15/W16 receipts.
- R2: V8.6 §26 (reversal) + G10 (product-relevance gate per merged unit).

## 4. Reuse / Invariants
Invariant: no merge executes from this issue; human runs each merge separately with PR matrix.

## 5. Failure Semantics
Verdict without W15/W16 receipts → BLOCKED.

## 6. Verification Gate + Receipt
Gate: per-branch verdict table ratified. Receipt: record.

## 7. OPEN_PIN triggers
Merge conflict with W1–W9 attic moves → re-scope, STOP that unit.

## 8. Sequence
Last. After W15, W16, and (for substrate parts) W10.
title: [GOV] W17: Branch-merge verdicts (d153 + perf/*)
